data.name: Etizaaz
data.long_meaning:
A name derived from the Arabic root 't-z-z', which denotes 'to give' or 'to bestow'. In Islamic context, Etizaaz signifies a gift or reward bestowed by Allah or a person of high status.

The term 'etiza' in Arabic can also mean 'a degree, rank, or title', reflecting the honor and respect associated with this name.

The name Etizaaz holds deep spiritual significance as it signifies the blessings and rewards that come one's way through faith, good deeds, and the grace of Allah.
